current.subject: Recap: late load detection validation and Thursday with Elena
current.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the time today, and to Mikkel and Grace. A quick recap.

- Ingest kept up at your volume of 4.7 billion events a month, with lag under four seconds at p95 when we replayed above your 38,000 per second peak.
- Your dbt models ran without a rewrite. Two use a macro that calls an external API at compile time; Grace's team will move that lookup into a seed table.
- The warehouse connector now uses continuous sync, about a minute end to end.

Open item: row level access for partners with sub carriers. Mikkel will send a sample of the hierarchy table on Monday, and Priya will show the policy working by Tuesday, October 6. Priya will also send the release note on continuous sync.

We are set for Thursday, October 8 at 2pm Central with Elena, focused on catching a late load while dispatch can still reroute it. We will bring a realistic onboarding plan.

Sam
